gaps.description: asyncpg is lazy-loaded by the worker PostgreSQL adapters but is not yet a frozen production dependency of lumi-worker-media.
gaps.closure: Add the runtime DB dependency through the deployment/package dependency lock and run the real worker with LUMI_RUNTIME_DATABASE_URL.

gaps.description: Celery task registration, routing, durable job state, retry, crash recovery and explicit Job DLQ are implemented, but media handlers are placeholder orchestration handlers rather than final image/video/export implementations.
gaps.closure: Bind job kinds to production media/AssetStorage handlers as those runtime adapters land.

gaps.description: QueuedAssetApiService and Project/Asset canonical event bridges exist, but production FastAPI composition does not yet atomically bind NODE-17/18 SQL repositories to runtime_jobs creation and canonical outbox envelope writes while the upstream production SQL repository gaps remain open.
gaps.closure: Bind Project/Asset transactions to canonical Outbox rows and durable JobScheduler rows in the same application transaction boundaries, then publish only from those durable rows.

gaps.description: Queue depth, retry, DLQ age and oldest-message SLO dashboards/alerts are not productionized in this node.
gaps.closure: NODE-67 observability wires RabbitMQ/Celery/PostgreSQL runtime metrics and alerts.

gaps.description: Canonical hosted validation is pending while GitHub Actions cannot allocate a runner because of the account billing/spending-limit condition.
gaps.closure: Fix GitHub Billing/spending limit and execute the committed NODE-19 workflow without source-only substitution.
